title: NOT EXISTS
narrative: Find students who are not enrolled in any courses.
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE students (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, major TEXT, gpa REAL NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE courses (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, credits INTEGER NOT NULL, department TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE enrollments (student_id INTEGER NOT NULL, course_id INTEGER NOT NULL, grade TEXT);
seed_sql: INSERT INTO students VALUES (1,'Alice','CS',3.9),(2,'Bob','Math',3.2),(3,'Charlie','CS',2.8),(4,'Diana','Physics',3.7),(5,'Eve',NULL,3.5); INSERT INTO courses VALUES (101,'Intro to CS',4,'CS'),(102,'Calculus I',4,'Math'),(103,'Physics I',4,'Physics'),(104,'Advanced CS',3,'CS'); INSERT INTO enrollments VALUES (1,101,'A'),(1,102,'A'),(2,102,'B'),(3,101,'C'),(4,103,'A'),(4,102,'A'),(1,104,NULL);

hints.content: NOT EXISTS is very efficient for finding missing relationships.

hints.code_snippet: SELECT name FROM students s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM enrollments e WHERE e.student_id = s.id);
